row.answer: Sion is a tank and fighter who charges into fights and threatens charged area knockups and stuns. His Q and R deal physical damage and scale with AD, while W grants health and a shield and W/E deal magic damage. After death, he briefly reanimates with rapid, healing attacks.
row.counterplay: Move away from his charged attacks and keep your distance after he dies.
